rows.title: 1h RSI(14) under 25 / over 75
rows.rules: Fade hourly RSI extremes until RSI crosses 50 or 6 h pass; stop 1.5 ATR.

rows.title: Pivot fade at R1/S1, all day
rows.rules: Rest limit orders at the pivot levels; target the pivot (or R1/S1), stop one level further.

rows.title: 15:00 UTC for 3 h, short if below VWAP
rows.rules: Every day at 15:00 UTC take the position (short if below VWAP) and close 3 hours later.

rows.title: 15:00 UTC for 4 h, short if below VWAP
rows.rules: Every day at 15:00 UTC take the position (short if below VWAP) and close 4 hours later.

rows.title: Short 15:00-19:00 UTC

rows.title: 15:00 UTC for 2 h, short if below VWAP

rows.title: US-open 60-min breakout, stop entry, stop at far side, 3R target, with 10-day trend
rows.rules: Opening range = the first 60 minutes from the NYSE open (13:30 UTC in US summer time, 14:30 in winter), weekdays only. Rest buy-stop and sell-stop orders at the two range edges; the first one touched is the trade, until 3 h 15 min after the open. Stop at the far side of the range, a limit target at 3.0x the risk; exit at the NYSE close. Only in the direction of the last 10 days' move.

rows.title: US-open 60-min breakout, market entry, stop at far side, 3R target, with 10-day trend
rows.rules: Opening range = the first 60 minutes from the NYSE open (13:30 UTC in US summer time, 14:30 in winter), weekdays only. Enter at market after a 1-minute close outside the range, until 3 h 15 min after the open. Stop at the far side of the range, a limit target at 3.0x the risk; exit at the NYSE close. Only in the direction of the last 10 days' move.

rows.title: US-open 30-min breakout, stop entry, stop at far side, no target, after a narrow-range day
rows.rules: Opening range = the first 30 minutes from the NYSE open (13:30 UTC in US summer time, 14:30 in winter), weekdays only. Rest buy-stop and sell-stop orders at the two range edges; the first one touched is the trade, until 3 h 15 min after the open. Stop at the far side of the range, no target; exit at the NYSE close. Only after a day whose range was the narrowest of the last four.
